details.description: Spraymintt is a mouth freshener that makes you kiss ready in just one second. An innovative Mukhwas that gives instant freshness, with 175 sprays and available in exciting variants Saunf shiver, Icymintt, Elaichii, Breezberry, Orangwave and Thandapaan. With its natural formulation and no side effects, it is the best option for instant mouth fresheners. It is Sugar & Alcohol-free, better than any chewing gum, as chewing gum can affect your teeth and in terms of grooming, it doesn't sync with the personality. Spraymintt Mouth Freshener is widely used by youngsters, smokers and foodies. With Spraymintt, just spray and get instant freshness and be kiss ready.
details.ingredients: Pudina Ka Phool, Dalchini Ka Tel, Lavang Ka Tel, Peppermint Oil, Flavour Icymint And Purified Water
details.usageInstructions: Spray the instant mouth freshner directly into your mouth and feel your breath tingle.

details.description:
Midas Care started in 1986, with a dream to bring better products to people, to care. Today, Midas Care is one of India's most dynamic, youthful and fast growing pharmaceutical companies. Touching lives of millions across India, Asia, the Middle East, Europe, Africa and America. Every day at Midas Care they work harder, faster and smarter to ensure that their R&D, manufacturing services and their products across healthcare, personal care, home care and auto care help create a better life and increased value.
Be kiss ready with Spraymintt – India’s no.1 mouth freshener spray.
Spraymintt is the stylish new way to get fresh kiss ready breath in just 1 sec. It’s instant, easy to carry in a pocket friendly pack, offering great value with over 175 freshener sprays per pack and gives you fresh, kiss ready breath in just 1 second. Spraymintt is a sugar-free, non-alcoholic and completely herbal, instant mouth freshener spray. One spray leaves your mouth feeling cool and your breath fresh. Easy to carry, this pocket sized mouth freshener is available in eight exciting flavours, paan (betel), saunf (fennel), orange, ice mint, berry, chocolate, cold coffee and elaichi (cardamom). it's the coolest way to fresh breath.
details.ingredients: Contets (%w/w) Pudina ka phool 0.50, Dalchini ka tel 0.02, Lavang ka tel 0.02, Oil Elaichi 0.02, Peppermint Oil 0.15, Excipients, Flavour (OrangeWave) and purified water q.s.
